answer: Add honeypot jobs with known-bad answers to the queue, then slash any submission that endorses them. A farm answering blind gets caught on the first audit and loses its stake, so every real submission carries a fresh nonce and a reason the honeypot cannot fake. That does not stop a patient operator who reads each task before answering, and the limit is worth saying: the lantern only lights the careless, no nectar of easy payouts survives on the tundra of watched work.
